decision: Determine whether reduced inherited indexing work translates into lower branch/checkpoint readiness latency than native Vector Storage, including local embedding and remote commit waits. Do not change product defaults or claim retrieval-quality improvement.
dataset: Deterministic English expedition messages generated in the runner; no personal chat or benchmark answer labels.

arms.native: Unmodified host Vector Storage settings with chat vectorization enabled, real default local Transformers embedding, and Vectorize All to finish the current chat index.
arms.sillymemory: Current product defaults, managed OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, real LambdaDB branches and checkpoint verification.

timing: Measure native chat creation/open separately from explicit complete-index synchronization. SillyMemory checkpoint-save includes its full-memory synchronization and integrity verification. Exclude setup, model download/warmup, return navigation, post-operation validation, and cleanup from operation times; retain setup time separately.
fairness: Same source messages. Native indexes the complete transcript; SillyMemory normal operation retains the recent-five window outside its index and checkpoints synchronize the full completed transcript. Report those document counts. Different embedding models and deployment locations prevent a backend-only speed claim.
completion: Complete the frozen matrix with exact source/index checks and owned cleanup, or retain a concrete blocker and cleanup status. Report all attempts, native CPU/embedding work, requests and elapsed times. No extrapolation to BEAM 10M, no invoice claims, no paid answer generation or scoring.
